description: A frozen copy of a task form as it stood when published. Each task is read with the version it was answered on.

fields.label: Task Type
fields.description: The form this frozen version belongs to.

fields.label: Version No
fields.description: 1, 2, 3 and so on, to order a form's versions.

fields.label: Is Current
fields.description: The version reps are offered and new tasks are answered on. Exactly one per form.

fields.label: Question Count
fields.description: The number of questions in the frozen version.

fields.label: Definition Hash
fields.description: The fingerprint of the frozen version. An unchanged save reuses the matching version instead of making a duplicate.

fields.label: Definition (JSON)
fields.description: The frozen form a task is read with.

name: CRM Task Type Version
